description: This file exports module-related constants and a complex diagram rendering object, including methods for adding requirements, elements, relationships, and rendering diagrams with D3.js, likely for visualizing requirement diagrams in a web application.

classes.name: V
classes.description: Parser class used for interpreting the requirement diagram source.

methods.name: addRequirement
methods.description: Adds a requirement object to the internal requirements store.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a diagram element (requirement or element) with specific type and documentation reference.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Records a relationship between two diagram elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all stored data and diagram state.
